## What

Extract project leaf SAN/EKU/rfc822 checks (e2/e3/e4, ~57 lines, lines 2336–2392) into `pub(crate) fn enforce_leaf_profile(...)`.

## Risk

Low-medium. Multi-check, no state mutation, but exercised by project profile rules (not just PKITS).

## Dependencies

- H4 (verify_cert_signature) — shares conceptual locality.
- H5 (check_issuer_linkage) — shares conceptual locality.

The deps are about helper-pattern consistency rather than code-level coupling. H6 reads cert and policy fields only.

## Acceptance

- New helper in pkix-path/src/lib.rs.
- chain_walk calls helper for the leaf cert (i == 0 branch).
- All PKITS tests pass.
- Project profile tests pass.
- clippy clean.
- No behaviour change.
